automated classification of images of cells from immunofluorescent staining.
developing automated pattern recognition methods to classify indirect immunofluorecence (IF) images of HEp2 cells into a set of predefined patterns.
the development of a pattern recognition system for the classification of indirect immunofluo-rescence (IIF) images of HEp2 cells.

The main takeaway from our work is that
a combination of simple texture features, sparse coding, and ensemble classification is sufficient to achieve high accuracy on a complex pattern classification task.
a combination of texture features with SVMs, trained on a large, artificially augmented dataset, and evaluated on heldout data, can achieve good results in a challenging pattern recognition task.
a system for automated recognition of immunofluorescent patterns in HEp-2 cell images is feasible.
